frog-stand-1.png: Full hold: the feet are off the floor and the toes pointed together behind the hips, the knees resting on the backs of the bent elbows. The elbows are bent at about 90 degrees angled out, the torso tilted forward, the back rounded and the head lifted looking forward.
elbow-lever-1.png: Full hold: the body is horizontal and straight, supported on the hands with the elbows bent at about 90 degrees and set into the hips. Legs together and straight, extended behind, the feet are off the floor and the head is lifted looking forward with the torso level.
planche-lean-1.png: Push-up plank position facing right with the hands on the floor under the shoulders, the fingers pointing forward or slightly outward. Arms straight, the body in a straight line from head to heels, the feet together on the toes.
advanced-tuck-planche-1.png: Full hold: the arms are locked straight, the shoulders far ahead of the hands, and the back is flat and horizontal. The hips are open so that the thighs are in line with the back, the knees bent at about 90 degrees with the shins pointing straight back, feet off the floor.
tuck-planche-1.png: Full hold: the arms are locked straight and the shoulders are pushed forward past the hands. The knees are tucked tight to the chest with the hips bent, the back is rounded slightly, the hips level with the shoulders and the feet are off the floor.
one-leg-planche-1.png: Switch legs: near knee tucks under torso and far leg extends behind, maintaining forward shoulder lean.
straddle-planche-1.png: Full straddle planche hold with straight arms and shoulders ahead of wrists.
full-planche-1.png: Full hold: the body is one straight horizontal line from the head to the pointed toes, a hand-length above the floor, supported only on the hands. The arms are locked straight, the shoulders are protracted, the legs are together and straight and the hips are level.
planche-push-up-1.png: Lowering midway: the body stays in the horizontal straight line as the elbows bend to about 90 degrees and tuck beside the ribs. The torso descends toward the floor and the shoulders stay forward of the hands.
front-row-hold-1.png: Pulling up: the elbows bend and travel back as the chest rises toward the bar. The body stays a rigid straight plank from the heels to the shoulders, the heels dig into the floor and the head stays in line with the spine.
skin-the-cat-1.png: Mid rotation: the body inverted beneath the bar, the hips above the head level with the bar and the legs passing between the arms. The shoulders are rotating behind the body and the arms are straight, the back arching slightly as the legs pass over.
tuck-back-lever-1.png: Lowering back: the arms stay straight as the tucked body rotates down behind the bar into a face-down position, hips and knees tucked in, the shoulders moving into extension. Keep the faceless head neutral and aligned with the spine, and show every joint angle of the Tuck Back Lever clearly in this side (facing left) view.
advanced-tuck-back-lever-1.png: Full advanced tuck back lever: flat horizontal back, shoulders and hips level, torso facing the floor. Hips bent around 90 degrees with thighs descending below pelvis; knees bent around 90 degrees with shins extending behind. Straight arms extend behind the torso to the bar. Neutral neck and head.
advanced-tuck-front-lever-1.png: Full hold: the torso is flat and horizontal with the arms straight and vertical. The hips are open so the thighs are in line with the back, the knees bent at 90 degrees with the shins pointing down. The knees are not tight to the chest, but the back stays flat, the shoulders pressed down.
crow-pose-1.png: Full hold: both feet off the floor, toes pointed and touching together behind the hips, shins resting on the backs of the upper arms. Arms straight or almost straight, back rounded and hips high, head lifted and looking ahead, shoulders forward of the wrists.
